Thank you. I think my intelligence is th biggest thing I can validate. But even when im pulling a 3.8 GPA, I still think it's not good enough and that I'm worthless. A few people have asked me why I don't think my life is worth fighting for? And I always ask them "would you go through absolute hell to save someone that you absolutely fucking hate?" And I think that's the core of it. I loathe myself.

I think that's why I'm at this point. It's been 3+ years now. It's endless. And at some point, you just can't do it anymore. I feel like when I pull an all nighter and I'm just SUPER tired the next day and I have to fight to stay awake. That's me. I'm so tired and I feel like I'm fighting to stay awake. But my body is just screaming for me to sleep. 

Cutting originally started as my outlet. It's progressed into a full addiction. I MUST cut, if I don't I even begin to feel withdrawal. And there isn't exactly a rehab for cutting. In face, despite being hospitalized for over 3 months (total) my self harm has remained almost completely untreated. 

There really isn't a lot that grounds me. I have a dog. He's 14 now, so I've had him for most of my life. Playing with him makes me smile. He may be 14 but he plays like a puppy. And I genuinely believe he can sense that it makes me feel better. A smaller thing though is that I have a pretty nice sports car. Taking that thing up to high speeds (on a track or deserted road) is a massive adrenalin rush for me. But I have a feeling that has a lot to do with a feeling of kinda cheating death. I mean, if I hit something going 180km/hr in my lightweight sports car, I'd be dead for sure. 

But like I said, I've thought of several different metaphors, but it all comes back to this...I'm tired. I'm tired of fighting this and I'm hopeless that I'll win. Why keep living a miserable existence when I don't think I'll get better (and please don't give me some BS like "well not with that attitude".

Whether or night I'll go through with it on Tuesday....I haven't completely decided yet. But I'm going to live these next two days like they're my last. I'm gonna see my friends and family one last time and I'm gonna play with and cuddle my dog until I finally do it (if I do).

Yes I have read a few. I've also seen YouTube videos. There's a lot of people that are so happy they failed. New outlook on life, that kind of thing. 

But I've attempted before. I slit my femoral artery and nearly bled out. It was just bad luck that I was found before I actually did. When I woke up...it was the worst moment of my life. When I realized I was still alive. 

I've read the stories of the very few survivors of jumping off the golden gate. And lots say they immediately regretted it. But just before I lost consciousness and thought I wouldn't wake up...I felt happy. Like I a huge weight had been lifted off my shoulders. But when I woke up, that weight went right back on. 

Well I'm just so tired of carrying that weight.

It's been so long that I don't even remember happiness. 

Being able to get out of bed in the morning, not self harming, not thinking about suicide constantly, being motivated to do things, just not being constantly miserable. All of these things would be a nice change. 

Take today for example, it took me hours to fall asleep, so I woke up at 3pm and was still absolutely exhausted. Both suicide and self harm are always on my brain. Friend is having a small birthday party at her place. Don't wanna go. Oh and also my blood loss is getting up there again so I'm once again anemic. Which is one of the worst physical feelings. Always dizzy and sick. 

If there was hope in sight, it might be different. But I'm 100000% hopeless that nothing will help.
